name: Carosso Riva
original_name: カルロッソ・リーヴァ
source:
A charming young man whom [Spoiler][url=/c93368]Suzuki Moe[/url][/spoiler] met at a high-class social gathering. 

[Spoiler]She's actually her stalker, who caused her trauma, making her afraid of being touched while also sparking her obsession with gigantic penises.[/spoiler]
